result.question: What happens when Gaal fights Abimelech?

readings.answer: Abimelech pursues Gaal, and Gaal flees.
readings.support: but Abimelech pursued him, and Gaal fled before him
And many Shechemites fell wounded all the way to the entrance of the gate

assessments.reason: Text says, “Abimelech pursued him, and Gaal fled before him,” which matches the key’s first part (Gaal flees), though it omits the key’s claim about many dying.
The passage says, “many Shechemites fell wounded,” which supports ‘many are wounded’; the key’s ‘many die’ is not established, so this is a supported, weaker alternative.

result.reason: The text says “many Shechemites fell wounded,” not that they died, so the key overstates the outcome.
